sources.citation: Green, E. Mara. 2024. Making Sense: Language, Ethics, and Understanding in Deaf Nepal. Oakland: University of California Press (Luminos open access). 242 pp. DOI 10.1525/luminos.193

sources.note: Nothing. Ethnography of 'natural sign' in Maunabudhuk and Bodhe; the words 'stress', 'phonology' do not occur in the text.
